summary: Iteration 64: Security Overhaul Testing - 6 Critical Security Fixes VERIFIED. All 19 tests passed, 2 skipped (rate limiting on user creation). P1 JWT secret, P1 payment gate, P2 rate limiting, P2 secure uploads, P2 CORS, P3 document ownership all working correctly.

manual_verification: Rate limiting on /client/login - VERIFIED via curl (429 after 5-6 requests)
Rate limiting on /client/register - VERIFIED via curl (429 after 5-6 requests)
Document ownership - VERIFIED via curl (owner=200, no_auth=403, fake_token=401)

P1_JWT_Secret_from_env.details: JWT_SECRET loaded from env var (config.py line 34-36). Server fails to start without it. Tokens work for admin login.

P1_Payment_gate_dossier_express.details: POST /api/dossier-express/submit returns 402 for fake/empty/missing session_id when STRIPE_API_KEY is set.

P2_Rate_limiting_auth.details: @limiter.limit('5/minute') on /client/login and /client/register. Returns 429 after exceeding limit.

P2_Secure_file_uploads.details: MIME whitelist (application/pdf, image/*, text/*, office docs). Extension whitelist. 10MB size limit. MZ header detection.

P2_CORS_strict_policy.details: ALLOWED_ORIGINS from env var, not wildcard '*'. Returns specific origin in Access-Control-Allow-Origin.

P3_Document_ownership_verification.details: GET /api/client/documents/{id}/download requires auth (403), validates ownership (404 for wrong user).

Additional_security_headers.details: X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, X-Frame-Options: DENY, X-XSS-Protection: 1; mode=block

Stripe_webhook.details: POST /api/webhook/stripe exists and validates payload (returns 400/500 for invalid data, not 404).

critical_code_review_comments: JWT_SECRET is mandatory - RuntimeError raised if not set (config.py:35-36)
Rate limiting uses slowapi with get_remote_address for IP-based limiting (config.py:13)
Payment verification does live Stripe check if DB lookup fails (strategiia.py:159-173)
File upload validates MIME type, extension, size, AND dangerous content signatures (client.py:758-789)
CORS origins loaded from ALLOWED_ORIGINS env var with SITE_URL fallback (server.py:28)
Document download queries by doc_id AND client_id for ownership verification (client.py:929)
SecurityHeadersMiddleware adds nosniff, DENY, XSS protection to all responses (server.py:38-48)

success_rate.backend: 100% (19/19 executed tests passed, 2 skipped due to rate limiting)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 64 verified all 6 security fixes. Rate limiting is IP-based (5/minute per IP across all rate-limited endpoints). Document ownership uses client_id from JWT token. CORS uses ALLOWED_ORIGINS env var. Payment gate requires valid Stripe session_id when STRIPE_API_KEY is set. All security headers are added by SecurityHeadersMiddleware.

mocked_apis_list: Stripe webhook uses test key sk_test_emergent - real payment verification not possible without live Stripe
